commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
backup_dir=/root/[REDACTED]
mkdir -p "$backup_dir"
for base in system-auth-ac password-auth-ac; do
  src=/etc/pam.d/$base
  if grep -q 'pam_faillock\.so' "$src"; then
    printf 'refusing: %s already contains pam_faillock directives\n' "$src" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  cp -a "$src" "$backup_dir/$base.before"
  tmp=/etc/pam.d/.$base.antrieb.$$
  awk '
    /^auth[[:space:]]+required[[:space:]]+pam_faildelay\.so/ {
      print
      print "auth        required      pam_faillock.so preauth silent audit deny=5 unlock_time=300"
      next
    }
    /^auth[[:space:]]+sufficient[[:space:]]+pam_unix\.so/ {
      print
      print "auth        [default=die] pam_faillock.so authfail audit deny=5 unlock_time=300"
      next
    }
    /^account[[:space:]]+required[[:space:]]+pam_unix\.so/ {
      print "account     required      pam_faillock.so"
      print
      next
    }
    { print }
  ' "$src" > "$tmp"
  test "$(grep -c 'pam_faillock\.so preauth.*deny=5.*unlock_time=300' "$tmp")" -eq 1
  test "$(grep -c 'pam_faillock\.so authfail.*deny=5.*unlock_time=300' "$tmp")" -eq 1
  test "$(grep -c '^account.*pam_faillock\.so' "$tmp")" -eq 1
  chown --reference="$src" "$tmp"
  chmod --reference="$src" "$tmp"
  if command -v chcon >/dev/null 2>&1; then chcon --reference="$src" "$tmp"; fi
  mv -f "$tmp" "$src"
done
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon /etc/pam.d/system-auth-ac /etc/pam.d/password-auth-ac; fi
printf 'configured canonical files; symlinks remain:\n'
ls -l /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth
printf 'directives:\n'
grep -Hn 'pam_faillock\.so' /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth
printf 'checksums:\n'
sha256sum /etc/pam.d/system-auth-ac /etc/pam.d/password-auth-ac
